data.name: Zophos
data.detailed_description:
Zophos is a classic survival horror inspired by the older generation of the genre—built around fixed camera angles, atmospheric exploration, and puzzle-driven progression.

You play as John, who wakes after a car crash with no clear memory of how he got there. A dense fog hangs over an abandoned place that feels disturbingly alive—like it’s listening. Searching for help becomes a descent into a village of locked doors, unanswered clues, and shifting silence. The deeper you push forward, the more the world starts to feel personal.

Zophos focuses on tension, pacing, and discovery. Every corridor is framed to hide something, every room hints at what came before, and every solution opens new routes through a connected environment. The clocks still tick here—and when they do, something moves in the dark.

Features:

  • Fixed camera survival horror inspired by classic genre foundations

  • Exploration-first progression through a fogbound village and a looming mansion

  • Puzzles and locked-path design that reward attention and revisiting locations

  • Cinematic atmosphere driven by sound, silence, and the ticking motif

  • Story-forward tone with psychological dread and grounded performances

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 with updates
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600 / Intel i5-8400
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 5700 / Nvidia GTX 1070 / Intel Arc A580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 with updates
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X / Intel i5-11600K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 (8 GB VRAM recommended)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Zophos contains horror imagery, violence, and disturbing scenes. Player discretion is advised.
